## Description

Scheduled job notifies owners 60/30/7 days before a doctor licence or facility registration expires and on expiry (doctor recording/signing then disabled again). Quarterly access review: owners get a task listing every active membership, role and last sign-in; they confirm or offboard each and the completion is recorded.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Expiry notifications are sent at 60/30/7/0 days and appear in the notification centre (D-03) and by email.
- [ ] **AC2.** On expiry, capabilities that require a verified licence are disabled server-side until renewed and re-verified.
- [ ] **AC3.** The quarterly review lists all memberships and records a decision per person; completion date is shown in settings.
- [ ] **AC4.** Both jobs are idempotent and audited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
